name: transcribe
description: Local speech-to-text: turn an audio or video file into a transcript, fully on-device via whisper.cpp. Tachyon provisions the pinned, checksummed ggml model (read-only) and detects + assist-installs the whisper-cli and ffmpeg system tools it needs. The audio content never leaves the machine; only the model weights are fetched once, pinned. Outputs txt (default) or srt/vtt/json. Not text-to-speech, not remote/paid transcription.
